question: Should pending Skill Workshop approval prompts be permanently bound to the proposal version that the operator reviewed, so revising a proposal invalidates its prior Approve, Reject, and Quarantine actions?
rationale: This is an intentional operator-facing authorization policy rather than a mechanical defect: it trades a possible extra review step for preventing an older prompt from applying or deciding a revised proposal.

options.title: Adopt version-bound approvals
options.body: Keep the fail-closed pending-approval behavior while preserving proposal-ID-only compatibility for direct lifecycle callers.

options.title: Keep approvals proposal-ID-only
options.body: Remove version binding from pending approval actions so an existing prompt can act on the newest pending revision.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-bound approvals
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed pending-approval behavior while preserving proposal-ID-only compatibility for direct lifecycle callers.
